title: Lean core: serve the harness HTTP surfaces in-tree without axum and futures
goal: Take axum (susi-vendor-axum: axum, axum-core, matchit, tower, serde_path_to_error, serde_urlencoded, sync_wrapper, mime, ...) and futures out of susi-harness, one of the four pillars. The BYOK OpenAI-compatible metering gateway (127.0.0.1:9188 for opencode and other clients, buffered and streamed SSE answers), the public ingress and the harness API (cockpit, JSON/SSE plus the guarded operator command) are served by a std, blocking, thread-per-connection HTTP/1.1 server in crates/susi-harness/src/http.rs. A transcript of real HTTP exchanges recorded from the axum 0.8 / hyper 1 stack first (status lines, header names, values and order, framing, chunk boundaries, bodies, connection reuse) is the golden the std server must reproduce byte for byte. Request size limits, timeouts (none server-side), authentication checks and loopback binding stay as they were.
host: CachyOS Linux x86_64 (CEO laptop, 28 threads), lane harnessstd, other agents' builds running
acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test architecture_tests --test orphan_sources --test lean_core_ceilings --test core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins --test no_github_coupling
live: target/debug/harness-gateway on a free loopback port against a local stand-in provider, driven with curl

results.wire_golden: 69 raw HTTP/1.x exchanges recorded from axum 0.8.9 / hyper 1.12 (bfd0a8eea) pass byte for byte against the std server (src/tests/http_wire.rs, golden/harness_http_wire.json)
results.susi_harness: 528 lib tests passed, 0 failed (including the wire golden and the server's own tests: graceful shutdown, handler drop on hang-up, header order, header value validity, HTTP dates); bin unit tests 5+6+6+5+5+5+8 passed; native_proxy_e2e 4/4
results.live: harness-gateway: /health 200; buffered completion 200 with the provider's body and a ledger row; streamed completion forwarded line by line as chunked (pieces 0.3 s apart as sent), row with the provider's usage; ingress 401 without a token, 200 and a row booked under the account with one; SIGTERM mid-stream: the stream and its row finished, process exited in 0.54 s, port closed
results.pillar_reach: third-party 154 -> 145 (axum, axum-core, matchit, tower, serde_path_to_error, serde_urlencoded, sync_wrapper, mime, ryu), workspace 41 -> 40 (susi-vendor-axum), direct facade edges 17 -> 16
results.lines: susi-harness 40,575 -> 39,446; production +1,859 (src/http.rs 1,843), inline test modules of gateway, ingress and cockpit (2,988 lines) moved unchanged to src/tests
results.build_graph: cargo tree -p susi-harness: 120 -> 107 packages; cargo tree -p susi: 243 -> 243 (axum stays for susi-gawd-a2a and susi-leaf-services); no build-time gain claimed

limitations: HTTP/2 prior knowledge (h2c), which axum's http2 feature accepted on these ports, is no longer served; every known client (opencode, the in-tree worker, the commercial desktop) speaks HTTP/1.1.
One thread per connection: an idle keep-alive connection holds a thread until the client closes it or the server stops (hyper held a task). There is no read or idle timeout, as there was none before.
axum's 15 s SSE keep-alive comment on /api/events is not sent: the stream sends a snapshot every second, so it never fired before either.

The JSON rejection path (serde_path_to_error's prefix) is reproduced by a syntax walk; it matches every recorded case (root, value, nested, array, unterminated, trailing comma, empty, wrong shape, missing/duplicate/unknown tag, wrong field type, trailing characters) but is not a general reimplementation of that crate.
Production lines of susi-harness grew by 1,859; the line ceiling falls only because 2,988 inline test lines moved to src/tests.
